first_loopback_attempt.counting: The failed attempt and single diagnostic overlap the final selection and are not added to 232 distinct passed tests.
failed_test_names: real OpenSSH forwarding through a verified jump route SOCKS domain request and pipelined binary payload survive request half-close
first_loopback_attempt.failure: The unchanged SOCKS >3MiB response exceeded its existing 20-second test bound while the independent Office and host qualifiers were also running.
first_loopback_attempt.resolution: After those gates finished, one exact unchanged SOCKS diagnostic passed, then the full unchanged loopback selection passed. Runtime contention is the supported explanation, not a proven isolated causal measurement. No production or test source, dependency or timeout changed.

limits: The existing optional real PTY case remained explicitly skipped; no privileged login-record fixture was requested.
Full native application and full terminal panel/backend graph builds were not run by this focused terminal harness.
